categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies net_processing.cpp and introduces blockdownloadman_impl.cpp to extract block download scheduling and peer state.
categories.rationale: Decomposes PeerManagerImpl by extracting block download scheduling and peer tracking into a standalone module with isolated unit and fuzz tests. This modularization improves the maintainability and testability of complex p2p relay logic, but it is an internal refactoring that does not fix an active bug or alter protocol behavior.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The added unit test and fuzz target specifically test the new P2P block download manager rather than general test machinery or frameworks.
categories.rationale: Does not touch testing framework machinery; tests specific to a subsystem belong to that subsystem's category.
